title: David’s Kindness to Mephibosheth

questions.question: For whose sake did David want to show kindness to the house of Saul?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 9:1 (ESV): "...that I may show him kindness for Jonathan's sake?"

questions.question: Who was the son of Jonathan that was still alive?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 9:6 (ESV): "And Mephibosheth the son of Jonathan, son of Saul, came to David..."

questions.question: What was Mephibosheth's physical condition?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 9:3 (ESV): "...There is still a son of Jonathan; he is crippled in his feet."

questions.question: What did David restore to Mephibosheth?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 9:7 (ESV): "...and I will restore to you all the land of Saul your father..."

questions.question: Where was Mephibosheth to eat always?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 9:7 (ESV): "...and you shall eat at my table always."

questions.question: Who was the servant of Saul that David called?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 9:2 (ESV): "Now there was a servant of the house of Saul whose name was Ziba..."

questions.question: Where was Mephibosheth living before David called him?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 9:4 (ESV): "...Behold, he is in the house of Machir the son of Ammiel, at Lo-debar."

questions.question: How did Mephibosheth refer to himself before David?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 9:8 (ESV): "...What is your servant, that you should show regard for a dead dog such as I?"

questions.question: How many sons did Ziba have?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 9:10 (ESV): "...Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants."

questions.question: Who was the master of the house where Mephibosheth was staying?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 9:4 (ESV): "...in the house of Machir the son of Ammiel..."

questions.question: What was the name of Mephibosheth's young son?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 9:12 (ESV): "And Mephibosheth had a young son, whose name was Mica."

questions.question: Who was tasked with tilling the land for Mephibosheth?
options: Ziba and his sons and servants
questions.correctAnswer: Ziba and his sons and servants
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 9:10 (ESV): "And you and your sons and your servants shall till the land for him..."

questions.question: How lame was Mephibosheth?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 9:13 (ESV): "...Now he was lame in both his feet."

questions.question: Mephibosheth ate at David's table like ______.
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 9:11 (ESV): "So Mephibosheth ate at David's table, like one of the king's sons."

questions.question: How many servants did Ziba have?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 9:10 (ESV): "...Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants."

key_verse_text: And David said to him, “Do not fear, for I will show you kindness for the sake of your father Jonathan, and I will restore to you all the land of Saul your father, and you shall eat at my table always.” (ESV)
